test_assessment.applicability: The recorded S2 execution reports package 1/1 and product-flow 16/16 passing plus scoped diff hygiene. These are caller-reported execution results; this reviewer inspected code and recorded evidence without rerunning expensive package installation. S1 and S2 documentation accurately retain S3 final claim and IPC/Android obligations; missing future slots are not S2 failures. Review does not advance the step or claim release readiness.
test_assessment.boundary: Uses release application copying, production dependency installation with ignore-scripts, current-source Cargo-built packaged analyzer, actual copied server/coordinator/importer/SQLite/Gateway and a restarted server process. Only external Codex transports are replaced; the internal send wrapper observes analyze and deliberately withholds positive ACK in the first child, then forwards normally on restart. Product Store helper only observes state; it no longer fabricates canonical publication. This is local package integration, not real external-host, installer, cross-platform or Android acceptance.
test_assessment.necessity: The expanded existing package smoke closes the confirmed C4-package gap: the former helper directly staged/published SQLite and could pass when server default analyzer or persistent recovery wiring was broken. One existing package target plus the reused product-flow regression is minimum-sufficient for S2.
test_assessment.oracle: Independent synthetic user/assistant literals are observed in Rust-produced canonical history. The smoke requires pre-ACK unpublished staging, absent canonical/checkpoint, durable intent/receipt/run, same job and batch with a new request after restart, unique item keys, canonical checkpoint, and authenticated gateway keys matching persisted history. Disabling default analyzer cannot reach held ACK; wrong recovery roots fail persistent-path and app/data negative assertions. Expected paths are independently constructed from install-root/persistent/data.
test_assessment.reason: Reviewed the Runtime cumulative four-file delta, including unchanged S1 CR and current S2 package test, product contract and draft CR. Actual S2 paths remain within node-tests/product-docs authority; no product source, forbidden path or new test file was changed.
test_assessment.reuse: Reuses and strengthens the admitted package test rather than adding redundant tests; reuses Rust build helper and existing sixteen-case product-flow target. Correcting an app/data-empty assertion to the exact four required history/recovery paths preserves the contract while excluding unrelated runtime data. Enabling active transport permits the real gateway selection path and does not replace it. No product oracle was relaxed.
